name: VHS lines
summary: Retro VHS tape overlay: rolling tracking band, noise lines, colour fringes and a PLAY label in the corner.

params.name: intensity
params.note: strength of the whole effect, 0 to 1

params.name: seed
params.note: change for a different noise pattern

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at
